name: Combustion Instability in Rocket Engines
summary: Coupling between combustion and chamber acoustics that can destroy rocket engines, and how engineers predict, test for and suppress it.

topics.name: Types of instability: chugging, buzzing and screeching
Chamber acoustic modes: longitudinal, tangential and radial
Damping devices: baffles, acoustic cavities and resonators
Stability rating: bomb tests and pulse guns
Instabilities in solid rocket motors and gas turbine combustors
Modern analysis: CFD-based and reduced-order models
